overlap_explanation.description: Raw fetch_wait_cycles and lsu_busy_cycles overlap because in Slice-0, fetch is held in REQUEST waiting for lsu_issue_ready while LSU transactions are inflight. Summing raw counters produces >100%. The disjoint_cycle_partition provides the exact non-overlapping distribution.
